topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: When I learned someone had tattooed my artwork on their skin, a peculiar sense enveloped me, far from any sudden surge of excitement or anger. There was something almost... quiet about it. My work, something I poured countless hours into, now lived beyond the confines of paper or canvas, transformed into a permanent part of another’s physical being. It was an odd form of flattery, one that bypassed the usual channels of praise or critique. It made me wonder about the person, their reasoning, the connection they felt. Yet, in that moment, I found myself simply observing, without rush, the intricate dance of creation and interpretation.
